title: Happy Birthday, My Love
subtitle: Today is all about you
letter: Today the world celebrates the day you were born, and I get to celebrate the person who makes my whole life brighter. I still remember the first time I saw your smile — the world stopped, and I knew I was done for. ❤️

You turn ordinary moments into my favorite memories. The way you laugh at silly things, the way you care about everyone so deeply, the way your eyes light up when you talk about something you love — I fall for you all over again every single time.
You know how Bubu can’t stay away from Dudu? That’s exactly us. I’m your Bubu — always wanting to hug you, hold you, and make you feel like the most loved person in the whole world. 🐻🐼
Every day with you is the best gift I’ve ever received. Happy birthday, my love. 🎁
